name: hunch
description: Ctrl+F with a hunch. A Firefox extension that lights up the paragraph that answers your question
author: tymscar

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run lint:ext
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts/chrome --overwrite-dest
